points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, props, metadata, toModel })` ... The flavour is a namespaced string such as `'affine:note'`. ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role`
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (for example `'hub'` or `'content'`), and `parent` and `children` whitelists. The whitelists can use role tags like `'@root'` and `'@content'`.
The model is a class extending `BlockModel<Props>`, for example `NoteBlockModel`.
The view is a Lit element extending `BlockComponent<Model>` ... Children are rendered with `this.renderChildren(this.model)` ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal`affine-note`)`
The store provider extends `StoreExtensionProvider` ... The view provider extends `ViewExtensionProvider`
`effect()` calls `effects()`, which defines the custom elements. ... The edgeless branch registers `affine-edgeless-note` instead.
